page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.totem-a: Aia ʻo Totem Astrology e kōkua iā ʻoe e aʻo e ʻōlelo maikaʻi i te mau ʻōlelo waiwai o kēlā me kēia a me ka ʻite ʻana i ka wā e makemake ai ʻoe i te mau mea like ʻole akā nele paha i ka huaʻōlelo e kamaʻilio e pili ana i kēlā mau ʻokoʻa. Ite mau ho'āʻo ka Monkey e kiʻi i ka Buffalo e piʻi i luna o kahi kumulāʻau, ʻaʻole paha makemake ka Buffalo i ka hoʻohewa ʻana a me ka hoʻopaʻa mau ʻana o ka Monkey "he maʻalahi! page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.using-t: Ma ka houtuafare ʻana i ka ʻōlelo o kēia ʻōnaehana hōkū, hiki iā mātou ke kamaʻilio e pili ana i kēlā mau ʻokoʻa ma ke ʻano he mea liʻiliʻi lākou no ka mea he mau hōʻailona animala kā mātou e hilinaʻi ai no ka ʻike. page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.it-also: Hiki ke kōkua iā mātou e ʻike i ka pili ʻana o te mau ʻāpana maikaʻi o te mau mea ʻē aʻe i te mau ʻāpana a mātou e ʻike ai he mau hemahema - no ka laʻana, hiki i kāu hoaaloha ke lohi pinepine i te mau koho, me he mea lā aia ko lākou poʻo i ke ao. Malia paha ua loaʻa iā lākou ka Cat a i ʻole ka Deer kekahi o kā lākou aratai, no laila e hui pū ʻia ka lohi me kahi maʻi olakino o ka noʻonoʻo moeʻuhane! A i ʻole he Tiga a Lio paha kekahi o kā lākou aratai, a ʻo ko lākou lohi pinepine ʻana no te mau koho i hoʻonohonoho ʻia e hui pū ʻia me ka mākaukau e hoʻomaka me ka wiwo ʻole e hana i ka manawa koke! ʻAʻole kēia he kumu no ka hana ʻino ʻole, akā he mau puka makani ia i te mau mea e hiki mai ana i loko ou a i ʻole kekahi kanaka ʻē aʻe - me ka pahuhopu e hoʻoponopono mau i te mau hemahema o loko a e lokomaikaʻi ma ke ala me te mau hemahema o te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe.
page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.these-a: He makana kēia mau aratai animala, ​​ʻaʻole he hoʻopaʻi! No laila e maʻalahi iā ʻoe iho, a e hele mālie i ka poʻe a puni ʻoe. page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.that-dr: E koi ana kēlā Dragon i ka mahalo (a ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o ka hāʻawi ʻana iā ia i ka hoʻihoʻi ʻana!), A e mahalo ana kēlā Cat i kou mahalo i kona wahi me ka ʻole e nāte mau mau i loko, a ʻo ia hoʻi e hoʻopōmaikaʻi ʻo ia iā ʻoe me te mau mea kupanaha i manaʻo ʻole ʻia i ka wā e kū ai ke ʻano aloha. page.faq.same-animals-different-people.p: A hiki mai kēia mea he nui:

Loaʻa paha iā ʻoe ka 7 o te mau Puʻuwai a me kahi Jack of Diamonds, akā pehea ʻoe e pāʻani ai iā lākou i ka pāʻani aia iā ʻoe a ʻokoʻa paha ke ʻano o waho, ʻoiai he mau kāleka like kāu. A i ʻole hiki iā ʻoe ke noʻonoʻo e like me te mau puke nui āu i heluhelu ai. Hiki i ʻelua mau taata ʻokoʻa ke heluhelu i te mau puke ʻehā like ʻole a laila hāʻawi i kahi haʻiʻōlelo i ka lā ʻapōpō e pili ana iā lākou a ʻelua mau haʻiʻōlelo ʻokoʻa loa, ʻoiai ma ke kumuhana like o kēlā mau puke ʻehā. ʻO ia ke ʻano o ka hana ʻana o te mau animala: aia lākou ma ke ʻano he encyclopedia no ʻoe e kiʻi ai i kou ola a pau, ʻaʻole kahi hana kilokilo e haʻi iā ʻoe ʻo wai ʻoe a ʻo wai ʻoe. ʻO ka ʻike wale nō āu e pili ana i kekahi o te mau makana i hāʻawi ʻia iā ʻoe.

A ʻaʻole ʻo Totem Astrology wale nō i ka honua, e like me te mau ʻāpana ʻē aʻe o kou ʻano āu e aloha ai, ʻaʻole nō hoʻi kou ʻano piha: kou lāhui, kou hoʻomana, ka ʻāina āu i hele mai ai, he mau mea koʻikoʻi kēia mau mea iā mātou iho, a ʻoi aku ka koʻikoʻi i kekahi manawa ma mua o kekahi, a ʻoi aku ka mea nui i kekahi poʻe ma mua o kekahi. ʻO ka mea like me Totem Astrology - he mea nui paha ia i kāu hana i kēia lā, ʻaʻole paha! Lawe iā ia me kahi paʻakai, manaʻo ʻia e ʻite a hoʻokipa - ma mua o ke kaumaha a i ʻole ka hōʻino, ua manaʻo ʻia he pōmaikaʻi! No laila e hauʻoli :)

article.values.power-triangle.p.the-powe: Kuhi ʻia ka Power Triangle ma o te mau animala 1, 5, a me 9 o ka zodiac: ka Squirrel, ka Dragon, a me ka Monkey.
article.values.power-triangle.p.the-squi: ʻO ka Squirrel, ʻo ia ka animala mua o ka zodiac, ke ʻimi nei e loaʻa ka mana. Hoʻomaka mua ia ma o ka makaʻala a me ka hoʻonohonoho ʻana i ka nohona - ʻohi ʻana i ka naʻauao, heluhelu i ka hierarchy, a hiki i mua o ka hoʻokūkū. ʻAʻole naʻe no ka makemake o ka ʻupena, no ka mea, ʻo te mau pūnaewele kahi e ola ai ka pōmaikaʻi: ʻo wai ka mea i ʻike i ka mea, ʻo wai ka mea e hoʻomalu i ke komo ʻana, ʻo wai ka mea i ʻimi mua i ka wā i hala ai ka hawk.

ʻO ka pilina o ka Squirrel me Power ma ke ʻano he mea ʻimi, makemake mau e loaʻa hou aku, akā ʻaʻole ma ke ʻano craven. No ka Squirrel, ʻoi aku ka like me ka pāʻani pau ʻole o ka mākaukau - kahi a lākou makemake e lanakila pinepine ai, ʻoiai ite mau hiki iā lākou ke ʻike i ka wehe ʻike ʻole ʻia a hoʻopaʻa paha i ka ʻike koʻikoʻi e uku ʻia i ka manawa kūpono. Loaʻa i te mau Squirrels kahi pilina o te mau mea aloha me ka mana: makemake maoli lākou i ka noho ʻana i mua, i kekahi manawa e hopohopo i ka poʻe e paʻa ana i ka ʻāina kiʻekiʻe, a ʻoliʻoli pinepine ʻia e ka hahai ʻana.
article.values.power-triangle.p.the-drag: ʻO ka pilina o ka Dragon i ka mana, ma kekahi ʻaoʻao, e like me ke te ariʻi o kēia huinakolu. He mana wale kona, a houtuafare e like me kona makemake. ʻIke ʻo ia i ke ʻano o te mau mea e pono ai, me ka hilinaʻi nui, a kuhikuhi iā lākou e hana pēlā me ka ʻole o ka haʻi ʻana. ʻO te mau Dragons te mau mea pale o ko lākou ʻāina, a nāte mau i te mau mea āpau ma lalo o kā lākou ʻike ma ke ʻano he aupuni pilikino.
article.values.power-triangle.p.they-can: Hiki iā lākou ke loaʻa i te mau mea aloha, te mau hoa, te mau papahana, a me te mau limahana, akā me ka loaʻa ʻana o ka mālama ʻana a me ka mahalo nui i ka maikaʻi. No lākou ka waiwai a lākou e mālama nei, a ʻike lākou i ka waiwai ke ʻike lākou. ʻO kā lākou ea maoli o ka mana, ʻoiai ite mau ʻaʻole lākou i aratai i ka ʻenehana i kahi hierarchy, ʻike lākou i kahi ala e hoʻopuka ai i te mau kuhikuhi, pinepine i ka huhū o ka poʻe i luna. ʻO kēia pilina me ka mana e hāʻawi iā lākou i ka mana kūlohelohe e kauoha i ke kikowaena, a ua hoʻokō nui ʻia lākou i ka wā e hāʻawi ai ko lākou ola iā lākou i ke ākea e hoʻololi i kēia mana.
article.values.power-triangle.p.the-monk: ʻO ka Monkey, ʻo ke kolu a me ka animala hope loa i kēia hui, hōʻike i ka mana e like me ka Mage. Hānau ʻia me ka ʻike innate o ka mana dynamics, a me te mau mea aloha nui i te mau pāʻani ponoʻī, houtuafare lākou iā ia me ka ʻike ʻole. No lākou, ʻo ka mea a lākou e hana nei he kūpono wale nō, akā mai ka manaʻo o te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe hiki ke nāte mau aku i kekahi manawa e like me te mau machinations paʻakikī. He akamai loa lākou, i kekahi manawa e hōʻike ana i ka ʻike liʻiliʻi i mea e lawe mālie ai i ko lākou hoa paio a puni i ko lākou ʻike.
article.values.power-triangle.p.their-po: Ua like ko lakou mana me ko ke Man Behind The Curtain in the Wizard of Oz. ʻAʻole pololei ma ke kahua e ʻike ai te mau mea a pau, akā naʻe e hana naʻauao i te mau mea e pono ai ke hana ma waho o ke kahua, no ka mea, ʻike lākou ʻo ka hoʻokō ʻana i ka pahuhopu ka mea nui loa, ʻaʻole ka mea e loaʻa ka hōʻaiʻē. Aia kekahi kumu i like ai ka leo o Monk a me Monkey: ʻoi aku ka hoihoi o lāua i te mau mea e hana nei ma hope o te mau hiʻohiʻona o ka hōʻike a mātou e kapa nei he ʻoiaʻiʻo. Ma ke ʻano he Mage o kēia huinakolu, ʻike ʻia ʻaʻohe mana o lākou i kekahi manawa, akā ʻo kēia wale nō ke ʻano.
article.values.security-triangle.p.the-s: Hōʻike ʻia ka Triangle Security ma te mau animala 2nd, 6, a me 10 o ka zodiac: ka Buffalo, ka ʻŌphi, a me ka Phoenix.
article.values.security-triangle.p.as-th: Ma ke ʻano he animala mua o ka triangle Security, ʻo ka Buffalo ka mea ʻimi i ka palekana. ʻO kēia ke ʻano o ka hana, kūpaʻa, a me ka hoʻolaʻa ʻana i kahi mea maoli. ʻIke ʻo ia i ka waiwai kūʻokoʻa o ka mea hiki ke hoʻopā maoli ʻia a hilinaʻi paʻa, a ke hoʻāʻo nei e hana i kēia ʻano paʻa i kona ola ponoʻī no ka poʻe i kūpaʻa iā ia. Hoʻomau ka Buffalo, makemake i ke ala kuʻuna a me te mau ʻano hana i hoʻāʻo ʻia a hoʻāʻo ʻia. ʻO ka hoʻoikaika mau ʻana e hoʻopuka i te mau hopena mau loa, no laila e hoʻokō ka Buffalo i te mau hana a te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe i haʻalele i ka wā ma mua.
article.values.security-triangle.p.they-: He hilinaʻi maoli lākou, a hoʻohuoi maoli i ka poʻe ʻaʻole. No lākou, ʻo ka pua ka mea nui, a ʻo ka mālama ʻana i ka palekana no kā lākou poʻe aloha he hōʻailona hanohano ia, akā naʻe e hoʻomanawanui ʻia ka nui o ka ʻeha e hoʻokō ai i kēia palekana. He mau matahiti paha ia, akā na ka Bufalo e kūkulu.
article.values.security-triangle.p.lying: E moe ana ma ka piko o ka zodiac ka ʻŌphi. ʻO ka houtuafare ʻana i ka hapa nui o kona ola piha, pili kino me ka Fenua, hoʻokomo ʻia ka naʻauao o ka honua, a hiki ke ʻite ʻia ʻo ia ka Mage of Security. Hoʻomaka i loko o te mau mea pohihihi o ke ʻano maoli o ka Security, ua lilo ka Snake iā ia, a no laila hiki ke loaʻa iā ia ma te mau wahi āpau.
article.values.security-triangle.p.snake: Hiki ke hoʻololi ʻia te mau nahesa, loaʻa ka manaʻo, intuitive o ka mea palekana a me ka mea ʻole. ʻO ko lākou palekana he mea huna, ʻoiai ʻaʻole lākou i ʻike paʻa i waho no ka mea ke loli mau nei lākou, akā ʻo ka ʻoiaʻiʻo ua loaʻa iā lākou ka hiki i kēia manawa ke hoʻokō i ka palekana i ka manawa hoʻokahi, i ka manawa koke, e hoʻohuli iā lākou iho a puni kēlā me kēia lālā a i ʻole ka hale e kokoke ana. ʻO ka mea huna i ko lākou maʻalahi a me ka hoʻololi ʻana, ko lākou makemake e hoʻoponopono iā lākou iho i mua o te mau kūlana. ʻAe lākou i te mau kūlana e like me lākou a hoʻoponopono iā lākou iho e like me, e hana wale ana e hoʻololi i te mau mea ite mau pono a i ka wā i hoʻopili paʻa ʻia i loko o ka hale.
article.values.security-triangle.p.the-p: ʻO ka Phoenix, e like me ke te ariʻi o kēia huinakolu, hoʻolaha i ka palekana. No lākou, ʻo ke kūpaʻa a me ka palekana ke ʻano o te mau mea, a ʻaʻole hilahila lākou e hōʻike i te mau mea ʻē aʻe. ʻO kā lākou hōʻike ʻana i ka palekana e hōʻoiaʻiʻo ia no ka poʻe aloha a puni lākou, no laila ke kauoha nei lākou ma ke ʻano Yin e hana ai ka Mōʻīwahine, ʻo ko lākou hele nui ʻana e hōʻike ana he palekana, palekana, a hoʻokipa.
article.values.security-triangle.p.they-: Nui lākou ma te mau hōʻikeʻike, a ʻike nui i ke koʻikoʻi o te mau hiʻohiʻona. ʻOliʻoli ka Phoenix i ka hoʻokipa, hōʻike ʻana, a me ka hoʻokele ʻana i ke kaiapuni. ʻIte lākou he mea hōʻoluʻolu a hoʻomaha hoʻi ka nani a me ka hōʻike ʻana o ka maikaʻi i ko lākou hōʻike ʻana i ka ʻōlelo hoʻohiki no ka palekana. He ʻano ia o ka ikaika i hōʻike ʻia ma o ka nani, e kuhikuhi ana i ka ʻaoʻao ʻākau ʻākau o ka lolo a manaʻo ʻia e ʻite ʻia ma o ka hōʻike ʻana ma mua o ka haʻi ʻana - ʻoiai ʻaʻole lākou e kānalua e haʻi iā ʻoe i ko lākou manaʻo. ʻO ka manaʻo he hoʻolaha, hōʻike, hōʻike - e waiho i waho, hōʻike i ka honua, e ʻike ʻia!
article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.th: Hoʻā ʻia ka Inspiration Triangle i te mau animala 3, 7, a me 11 o ka zodiac: ka Tiga, ka Lio, a me ka Wolf.

ʻO ka Tiger, ʻo ia ke te ariʻi o kēia huinakolu, hoʻokomo i ka Inspiration e like me ke ʻano o ka lapalapa e hāʻawi ana i ka wela. ʻO ka hanohano, ka manaʻoʻiʻo, a me ka ʻoiaʻiʻo o ka mea e pono ai, ʻaʻole ia he mau mea e hoʻopaʻapaʻa ai - hoʻomālamalama wale lākou mai ia mea. Manaʻo kekahi i ka maikaʻi ma mua o ka haʻi ʻia ʻana o kahi huaʻōlelo: hoʻokiʻekiʻe ʻia, hoʻopiʻi ʻia, hoʻomanaʻo ʻia e hiki ke wela ke ola a ʻoi aku ka nui. ʻAʻole hahai ka Tiga i ka Inspiration e like me ke kū ʻana ma ke ʻano he hōʻoia ola.

He poʻe mālama ikaika lākou i ka mea a lākou e manaʻoʻiʻo ai, a ʻaʻole maopopo ka mana o kēia aupuni. ʻO te mau mea pale o te mau kumu, te mau mea aloha, a me te mau hihiʻo like, pale lākou i ka nani a me ka ʻoiaʻiʻo me ka makemake e hoʻokaʻawale ʻole - ʻaʻole ma ke koi ʻana i ka ʻoiaʻiʻo, akā ma ke aratai ʻana i te mau hiʻohiʻona a hiki i te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe ke koho e hahai. ʻO kā lākou ʻano charisma maoli ʻoiai ʻaʻole lākou i hoʻokele mana, ʻike ʻia ka lumi e pili ana i ko lākou manaʻo i ka mea nui. Ma ke ʻano he te ariʻi o kēia huinakolu, paʻa ka Tiger i ke kikowaena o Inspiration me ka ikaika ʻole, a ʻoi loa ka hoʻokō ʻana i ka wā e hāʻawi ai ke ola iā lākou i ke ʻano e hoʻokomo i ka mea kūpono i ka ʻike piha o ka honua.
article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.as: Ma ke ʻano he animala ʻelua o ka huinakolu Inspiration, ʻo ka Lio ka mea ʻimi i ka Inspiration. ʻO ia ke ʻano o ka pōloli hoʻomaha ʻole no ka lewa ākea - no ka puʻu e hiki mai ana, ka mea e hiki mai ana, ka ʻike aʻe o ke ʻano o ke ola ite mau e holo mau ana kekahi i laila. ʻAʻole mahalo wale ka Lio i te mau manaʻo mai kahi mamao aku; holo ia lakou. ʻO ke kūʻokoʻa kāna kālā, a ʻo ka makani i kona mane ka manaʻo o ka hilinaʻi ponoʻī. Ke hopu kekahi mea i kona noʻonoʻo, holo ka mea holoʻokoʻa i mua: kuʻi maiʻu, ʻike ākea, waiho ʻia ke ao honua i ke ao lepo a me ka ʻōlelo hoʻohiki.
article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.th: ʻO kā lākou pilina me Inspiration ʻo ia ka mea hahai pono, pili mau i ka mea hiki ke lilo ma mua o ka mea wale nō. Makemake lākou i ka hewa, i kekahi manawa kuhi hewa i ka hauʻoli o ka holo no ka hōʻea ʻana i ka pahuhopu ponoʻī. Eia naʻe, ʻo kēia ʻano hoʻomaha ʻole kā lākou makana: lawe lākou i te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe i ko lākou ala ʻana, a hiki i kā lākou ʻano maʻi ke hoʻāla i te mau hui āpau i kā lākou makemake ʻole. No ka Lio, ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻomanawanui ʻia kahi mea maikaʻi ʻole me ka neʻe - a no laila holo lākou, lele, a aratai mai ke alo.

ʻO ka Wolf, ʻo ke kolu a me ka animala hope loa i kēia hui, hōʻike i ka Inspiration e like me ka Mage. Hoʻomaka ʻia i loko o te mau mea pohihihi hohonu o ke kumu kūʻai maoli a me ke ʻano maoli o lākou, ʻike ka Wolf ʻaʻole leo nui a ʻike ʻia ka Inspiration. I kekahi manawa ke neʻe nei ma o ka ʻoiaʻiʻo, ma o ka pūʻulu, ma o te mau mele i mele ʻia i ka pōʻeleʻele a me te mau hoʻolālā i waiho mālie. Ua ʻike lākou i ka hānai ʻana i ka lapalapa me ka ʻole o ka wela i ka honua.
article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.wo: ʻO te mau ʻīlio he mea hoʻolālā hoʻolālā. Hiki iā lākou ke ʻike i te mau hihiʻo e hoʻomau a pau, a hoʻolilo lākou e like me - i te mau taata, i te mau kumu, i ka pō lōʻihi ma mua o ka wanaʻao. ʻO kā lākou hoʻoikaika ʻana he pilina a ʻāhiu, paʻa i ke ʻano no ka makaʻu ʻole i ka ʻaoʻao untamed. ʻAʻole paha ʻo lākou ka mea mua e haʻi i ka moeʻuhane, akā ʻo lākou ka poʻe e mālama i ke ola i ka wā e pau ai ka naʻau o kekahi. Ma ke ʻano he Mage o kēia huinakolu, ʻike ʻia ka Wolf i kekahi manawa he hana a mālama ʻia paha, akā ma lalo o ia mea e waiho nei i ka hilinaʻi i ka mea maikaʻi e like me ka huhū a me ka hoʻomau ʻana e like me ka hoʻoilo ponoʻī.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-ha: Hōʻike ʻia ka Harmony Triangle ma o te mau animala 4, 8, a me 12 o ka zodiac: ʻo ka Cat, ka Deer, a me ka Bea.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-ca: ʻO ka Cat, ʻo ia ka Mage o kēia huinakolu, ʻite iā Harmony i ke ʻano o ka ʻite ʻana o ka pōpoki i kahi kukui lā - ʻaʻole ma ka nāte mau ʻana iā ia, akā ma ka hoʻonohonoho ʻana iā ia me ke ʻano kūpono. Pāʻani, quirky, a uncannily laki, hoʻohui lākou i ka ʻono a me ka ʻoi i ke ana like, me ka ʻike pono i ka wā e hoʻopalupalu ai i kahi lumi a me ka wā e ʻā ai ka maiuu. Lele koke ko lākou nāte mau ʻana e like me ka hana ʻana, a me kēlā me kēia lele e hoʻoponopono lākou i ke ʻano o ka naʻau me ka ʻike ʻole o kekahi i ke ʻano o ia mea.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.cats-d: ʻAʻole haʻi aku te mau pōpoki i ka maluhia; ʻenehana lākou. ʻO kahi purr i hoʻopaʻa ʻia, kahi mea hoʻohenehene, kahi hoʻololi koke o ke kumuhana i hāʻawi ʻia me ka leʻaleʻa ʻaʻohe wahi e pae ai ka huhū - ʻo ia kā lākou mea hana. ʻO lākou te mau haku o ka pā māmā, hoʻihoʻi i ke kaulike ma o ka naʻauao ma mua o ke kaumaha, a ʻo kā lākou makana ʻo ka hoʻoikaika ʻana i ka lokahi ʻoiai ke akamai maoli ka hana ma hope. Ma ke ʻano he Mage o kēia huinakolu, ʻike ʻia ka Cat i kekahi manawa me ka makemake iā ia iho a i ʻole ke alo, akā aia ma lalo o ka hoʻoponopono hohonu ʻana i ke ʻano o ka hui a me ka hilinaʻi mālie i ka mālama ʻana.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.as-the: ʻOiai ʻo ka animala ʻelua o ka huinakolu Harmony, ʻo ka Deer ka mea ʻimi o Harmony. Ka Deer Pohihihi — mea pohihihi ia lakou iho. ʻO kekahi mea e pili ana iā lākou he mea ʻē aʻe: ʻoluʻolu a ʻano ʻē, me he mea lā hoʻokahi wale nō ko lākou wāwae i kēia ana a ʻo kekahi e ʻimi nei i kahi palupalu, mālie, ʻoi aku ka maʻalahi. Ua huki mau ʻia lākou i ka maluhia ʻaʻole ma ke ʻano he wahi i hoʻopaʻa ʻia akā ma ke ʻano he manaʻo o ka pololei, kahi kaulike ma waho o ka laina lāʻau i hiki iā lākou ke ʻono akā ʻaʻole loa e paʻa.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.their-: ʻO kā lāua pilina me Harmony ʻo ia ka mea hahai mālie, hoʻopili mau i ka hakakā a me ka makemake e hoʻihoʻi i ka mea i hāʻule ʻole. Pilikia lākou i ka hewa, i kekahi manawa nalo lākou i loko o ko lākou ʻāina i loko o ka ulu ʻana o ka honua i waho, akā naʻe ʻo kēia ʻano naʻau kā lākou makana: ʻike lākou i ka mea a te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe e nalo nei - ʻo ka haʻalulu liʻiliʻi o ka leo, ka lokahi e hiki ke hoʻi ite mau hoʻomanawanui kekahi e kali. No ka Deer, pono ke ʻimi ʻia ka maluhia ite mau ʻaʻole paʻakikī, a ʻo kā lākou hoʻomau mālie e lawe pinepine ai i ka noho mālie i te mau lumi ʻaʻole i ʻike i ko lākou hoʻomaha.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-be: ʻO ka Bea, ma ke ʻano he te ariʻi o kēia huinakolu, hoʻokomo ʻo Harmony ma ke ʻano maʻamau e like me ka hāʻawi ʻana i ka pumehana. ʻO ka Bountiful Bear - me ka ʻoluʻolu o ka loaʻa ʻana o ka ipu gula ma ka hope o ke ānuenue, e ʻoliʻoli i ka meli i loko, a kaʻana like me te mau mea a pau a lākou e aloha ai. No lākou, ʻo ka maluhia a me ka nui ka mea e pono ai ke ola, a ʻo kā lākou lokomaikaʻi e hana ai pēlā. Noho kekahi poʻe me ka nīnau ʻole ʻia mai, me he mea lā e hoʻomanaʻo ana kekahi wahi kahiko o ka ʻuhane i kēia manawa, ua lawa.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.they-a: ʻO lākou te mau mea pale o ke ola maikaʻi, ʻaʻole ma ka ikaika akā ma ka nui. ʻO kahi papaʻaina piha, kahi lua hoʻokipa, makemake e hoʻokuʻu wale i te mau mea aloha - ʻo ia ke ʻano o ka noho aliʻi ʻana o ka Bea. ʻIte lākou ʻo ka lokahi maoli ʻaʻole ka nele o ka pilikia akā ʻo ka noho ʻana o ka puʻuhonua: kahi e ʻono ai ka hauʻoli, e hoʻomaha ai, a hiki ke hoʻohele ʻia ka ʻono me ka ʻole o ka helu a me ke kūlana. Ma ke ʻano he te ariʻi o kēia huinakolu, ua paʻa ka Bea i ke kikowaena o Harmony me ka mana wikiwiki ʻole, a ʻoi loa ka hoʻokō ʻana i ka wā e hāʻawi ai ko lākou honua i kahi lumi e ʻohi ai, hānai, a māhele.
article.values.rainbow-companions.p.hidd: Huna ʻia i loko o ka zodiac e like me ke daimana, hoʻohui te mau hui ʻeono ʻo Rainbow i te mau animala Yin a me Yang i ka hui pū ʻana. Hoʻohālikelike kēlā me kēia pālua i ka ikaika o loko a me waho - ʻo kekahi e aratai i ka honua, ʻo kekahi e hoʻohonu, hoʻoluʻu, a hoʻopau paha i ka mea i hoʻomaka mua. Ke ʻike ʻia te mau mea ʻelua i loko o ka pou totem o ke kanaka, a i ʻole ka pilina pili, ʻike pinepine lākou i kekahi i kekahi i ke kaupaona kūlohelohe.
article.values.shadow-companions.p.each-: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia animala kekahi hoa Shadow - ka hoʻohuli ʻana o kāna paʻa Anuenue. Ma kahi e huki ai ke Anuenue i te mau kala ʻoiaʻiʻo ma o ka mālamalama, ʻeleʻele ka Shadow, e hōʻike ana i te mau hemahema me ka maopopo loa (ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o ka hoʻomaikaʻi ʻana iā lākou!). ʻO te mau mea paʻa ʻelua he magnetic ikaika; ʻO ka ʻokoʻa ka hōʻike ʻana o ke Ānuenue i te mau mea e ʻālohilohi nei, aʻo ka Shadow e hōʻike i te mau mea e pono ai ke alo a hana ʻia. Pono mātou i te mau mea ʻelua ma kēia ao, a no laila ua hoihoi pinepine mātou i te mau mea ʻelua! ʻAʻohe mea e pakele ai i ka Shadow: hāʻawi ia i ka makana paʻakikī o ka hōʻike ʻana i te mau hemahema a me te mau ʻokoʻa, no laila hiki ke hana ʻia ma mua o ka pale ʻana.
article.values.h2.the-dragon-the-cat-two: ʻO ka Dragon & The Cat — ʻElua mau Lens ʻokoʻa ma ka koho like
article.values.p.for-example-the-dragon-: Eia kekahi laʻana, aia ka Dragon i ka Power Triangle. ʻO ia ke ʻano o ka hoʻoholo ʻana i te mau mea e pili ana i ka hopena o kona mana. Aia ka Cat i ka Harmony Triangle, no laila e hoʻoholo i te mau mea e pili ana i ka hopena o kona maluhia. I ka hoʻoholo ʻana ma waena o te mau papa hana ʻē aʻe, e kau ka Dragon i ke koʻikoʻi nui ma luna o te mau hopena no kona kaulana, ʻoiai ʻoi aku ka hopohopo o ka Cat i ka pilikia a ʻaʻole paha.
article.values.p.the-dragon-may-thus-cho: No laila, hiki i ka Dragon ke koho i kahi hana hakakā e ʻohi ai i te mau pōmaikaʻi ma ke aupuni o ka Mana a me ka Prestige, ʻoiai hiki i ka Cat ke koho i kahi ala ʻoi aku ka makaʻala, e ʻimi ana i ka mālama ʻana i kona Maluhia a me ka Harmony.
article.values.p.neither-animal-welcomes: ʻAʻole hoʻokipa kekahi animala i ka inoa maikaʻi ʻole a i ʻole ka hoʻohaunaele ʻana i ka lokahi, akā ke koi ʻia lākou e koho i kekahi a i ʻole kekahi, e hana lākou i te mau koho ʻokoʻa e pili ana i te mau waiwai a lākou e koho ai.
article.values.p.the-cat-has-a-relativel: He ʻoi aku ka ʻoi aʻe o ka ʻae ʻana o ka Cat no ka nalo ʻana o ka hanohano, hiki iā ia ke hoʻoluliluli iā ia iho a lele me ke poʻo kiʻekiʻe me he mea lā ʻaʻohe mea. Makemake ʻo ia e hoʻi i ka maluhia a me ke kaulike, ʻoiai ʻo ka mea liʻiliʻi e hiki ke mālama i kahi Dragon i ka pō, e ʻai ana i ka nalowale o ka maka.
article.values.p.meanwhile-the-dragon-ca: I kēia manawa, hiki i ka Dragon ke mālama i ka nui o ka malu i hoʻolei ʻia e ka poʻe nona ka hulu i hoʻoheheʻe ʻia e kāna mau hana, me ka ʻae ʻana i te mau haunaele pōkole o ka maluhia e like me ke kumu kūʻai o ka hahai ʻana i kāna mau pahuhopu. Makemake ʻo ia e hoʻokō i kēlā mau pahuhopu a nāte mau pono i ka makana, ʻoiai e ʻoi aku ka pilikia o ka Cat i te mau manaʻo ʻino i loko o ka hui.
article.values.p.neither-is-right-or-wro: ʻAʻole pololei a hewa ʻole, a ʻo te mau ala ʻelua i ko lākou ikaika a me te mau nāwaliwali - ʻo ia ka mea kilokilo o ka pili Shadow, no ka mea e hōʻike ana i kēia mau ʻokoʻa ite mau ʻaʻole mātou e haʻalele iā lākou a manaʻo paha he "hana hewa" te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe :)

article.fourGuides.p.spirit-mind-heart-a: Vārua, noʻonoʻo, puʻuwai, a me ke kino - ʻehā mau hoa pili animala i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma kāu pou totem, i hōʻike ʻia ma o te mau pou ʻehā o kou hānau ʻana.
article.fourGuides.p.totem-astrology-bui: Totem Astrology builds on the Chinese Four Pillars of Destiny — birth year, month, day, and hour. Each pillar reveals one totem animal ally: your Spiritual, Mental, Emotional, and Physical guides.
article.fourGuides.p.the-year-pillar-spe: ʻO ka pou matahiti e kamaʻilio i kou ʻuhane ʻuhane - ke ākea ākea o ka mea āu e hele nei ma ke ao holoʻokoʻa. Hoʻohālikelike ka pou ʻavaʻe i kou noʻonoʻo a me ka hana ʻana i ka honua. Hiki ke kia lā i loko o ka puʻuwai - pehea kou manaʻo, pili, a koho i ka hale keaka pili o ke ola o kēlā me kēia lā. Hoʻokumu ke kia hola i ke kino - ke ʻano, ka ikaika, a me ke kani kino āu e neʻe ai i ka honua me.
article.fourGuides.p.picture-them-stacke: E kiʻi iā lākou i hoʻopaʻa ʻia e like me ka pou totem — Body ma ke kumu, Heart ma luna, Mind ma hope, a me Spirit. ʻO kēia mau animala ʻehā ʻaʻole ʻehā horoscope kaʻawale i hoʻopili pū ʻia. ʻO lākou hoʻokahi pole totem - ʻehā mau ʻaoʻao o ka manawa hānau hoʻokahi, kēlā me kēia me kāna ʻano ponoʻī a me ka polarity Yin a Yang o kēlā animala.
article.fourGuides.p.enter-your-birth-da: E hoʻokomo i kou lā hānau, ka manawa, a me ke kūlanakauhale ma ka Totem Animals Calculator. Ma hope o ka ʻike ʻia ʻana o kāu pole totem, kaomi i kekahi kāleka animala e heluhelu i kahi aratai kikoʻī e pili ana i kēlā totem, kāna mea, a me kona ʻano Yin a i ʻole Yang.

article.elements.p.water-wood-fire-earth: ʻO ka wai, ka lāʻau, ke ahi, ka honua, a me ka metala - ʻo kēlā me kēia ʻāpana o kāu pole totem e hui pū i kahi animala me kekahi o kēia mau mea ʻelima, e hoʻohui ana i kahi papa kuhikuhi pololei i kāu aratai animala ʻuhane, noʻonoʻo, naʻau, a me ke kino. Hiki ke noʻonoʻo ʻia te mau ʻElima he ʻelima mau hiʻohiʻona no ka neʻe ʻana o ka ikehu - kēlā me kēia me kona kuhikuhi ponoʻī, loiloi, a me te mau ʻōlelo Yin & Yang.
article.elements.p.in-chinese-cosmology-: I loko o ka Chinese cosmology, neʻe lākou i loko o kahi pōʻai mau: hānai ka wai i kona ikehu hānai i ka lāʻau i hiki ai iā ia ke ulu i kona mau hale he nui, a laila hāʻawi te mau lālā a me te mau lau o Wood i wahie no ka umu ahi o ka hoʻololi ʻana, ka mea e hana ai i ka lehu a me te mau ʻehu e noho ai e lilo i Fenua, a laila hoʻokomo ka Honua i ka mālie, ke kaumaha, a me ke kaomi e lawe i ka ʻala metala a hoʻokumu i te mau Crystals hou e hoʻomaka ai i ka wai.
article.elements.p.inside-that-same-circ: I loko o kēlā pōʻai hoʻokahi, hana ʻia kahi ʻano lua i kahi pentagram - ka pōʻai hoʻomalu. Mālama kēlā me kēia mea i kekahi: Hiki ke kāpīpī ʻia ka wai i ke ahi i ʻole e puka i waho o ka lima, Hoʻomaʻamaʻa ke ahi a hoʻopalupalu i ka Metara i hiki ke hana me ka maʻalahi, ʻoki ka ʻoi o ka Metal i ka lāʻau e ʻohi i te mau mea nui, pili te mau aʻa o ka lāʻau e hoʻopaʻa i ka Fenua, a hoʻopaʻa ka honua i ka wai a hoʻohuli hou iā ia ma ka hana ʻana i te mau kahawai.
article.elements.p.on-your-calculator-re: Ma kāu calculator results, ʻike ʻia kēlā me kēia mea aratai ma kāna kāleka. E kaomi i kekahi animala e heluhelu i ka hui ana o ia mea a me ka polarity ma kou pou totem.
article.elements.p.water-brings-everythi: Lawe ka wai i te mau mea a pau i loko a hoʻokahe i lalo. Hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻike maopopo loa i kēia ma ka ʻaoʻao o kahi kahawai - i ka wā mua e kahe ana ka wai mai te mau wahi kiʻekiʻe a puni e ʻākoakoa i waenakonu a lilo i muliwai. Huli ka muliwai i lalo a puni a hiki i kahi e hāʻule nui ai a lilo i wailele! Ua kahe ka ikehu a pau mai na kiekiena o na mauna, a i lalo i ke awawa, e lele ana ma na aoao he nui, a hiki i ka manawa e hui ai kela mau lala a pau i hookahi wale no, a lele aku kela ma ka lihi a haule i ka hohonu loa malalo, e lawe ana i ka wai ilalo i ke kumu o ka umekaumaha.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-water: Ma kona ʻano Yin, ua like ka wai me ke kahawai, ka noe, a i ʻole ka ua - ʻoluʻolu a hoʻomanawanui, e komo ana i loko o kēlā me kēia māwae a ʻike i ke ala ʻoi loa ke kūʻē ʻana ma mua o ke koi ʻana i kona ala. Hānai mālie ʻo Yin Water, ʻākoakoa i te mau wahi huna a hoʻokuʻu i ka manawa e hana i ka hana o ka ʻaʻahu ʻana i ka pōhaku. ʻAʻole pono e hoʻolaha iā ia iho; e kahe wale ana, e hoʻololi i te mau ʻano like ʻole o ka honua a hiki i ka palupalu a hānai ʻia te mau mea a puni. Ma kona ʻano Yang, ua like ka wai me ka moana nui - e kahe ana i loko a i waho me ke kai, e hāʻule ana i te mau nalu nui i te mau pōhaku, e paʻi nui ana. ʻO Yang Water ka mea e kū nei i mua ona, hoʻololi hou i ke kahakai me ka ikaika mau, hiki ʻole ke nāte mau ʻole a paʻa i ka wā e neʻe ai kona kaumaha.
article.elements.p.wood-starts-as-a-seed: Hoʻomaka ka lāʻau ma ke ʻano he hua i waenakonu a puka koke te mau lālā i ʻelua ʻaoʻao ʻē aʻe - hoʻouna ʻo ia i kahi aʻa e lele ana i lalo i ka honua me ka ulu ʻana i kahi kumu i luna i ka lā. Puka mai kona lau mua e ohi i ka ikehu mai luna mai, a e hoonui ana kona kumu kumu mua e komo i ka wai a me na minela mai lalo mai. Mai laila mai, hoʻomau i ka lālā fractally, ke kaulike mau i ka ulu hou ma luna o ka ʻili me ka ʻimi ʻana i lalo o ka honua. Māhele te mau ​​aʻa a mohala ma lalo e like me ka hili ʻana o te mau lālā a ulu hou i luna. Hele ka neʻe ʻana mai ke kikowaena a hiki i waho, lālā a wili i te mau ʻaoʻao āpau.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-wood-: Ma kona ʻano Yin, ua like ʻo Wood me ka ʻohe a i ʻole ke kumu waina - ʻoi aku ka maʻalahi a hiki ke hoʻololi ʻia, akā ʻoi aku ka hilinaʻi ma luna o te mau mea ʻē aʻe, hiki ke houtuafare i te mau mea a puni e kōkua i kāna ʻimi ʻana i ka mālamalama i kona piʻi ʻana. ʻAʻole e haki ʻo Yin Wood i kahi ʻino - hiki iā ia ke kūlou me ka makani. Ma kona ʻano Yang, ua like ia me ka lāʻau ʻoka nui a i ʻole ka ʻulaʻula - ʻoi aku ka ʻoʻoleʻa a ʻoʻoleʻa, akā kūʻokoʻa a pale, e piʻi ana ma luna o ka ululāʻau a hāʻawi i ka hale, ka uhi, a me ka malu no ka poʻe ma lalo. Hiki iā Yang Wood ke kū ikaika i te mau ʻino liʻiliʻi, akā i ka hopena, e haki ka ʻōpala ikaika loa ma lalo o te mau ʻino ikaika a paʻa paha.
article.elements.p.fire-can-be-seen-as-t: Hiki ke ʻike ʻia ke ahi ma ke ʻano o ka wai - kahi e kahe ai ka wai i ka ikehu i loko a i lalo, hoʻololi ke ahi iā ia ma ka hoʻouna ʻana i waho a i luna. Lawe ke ahi i te mau hale o ka lāʻau i noho mua ʻia, me ka paʻakikī a pau, a hoʻopau iā lākou - puhi a hoʻololi iā lākou, e puhi ana i te mau ʻōpala a me ka ea wela i waho a i luna e hana i kahi mea hou mai ka luku ʻana: wela, māmā, a me ka lehu ahi e hāʻule i lalo a lilo i honua. Hoʻokuʻu ke ahi i te mau mea ma hope o kona ala ʻana, e waiho ana i kahi ākea ākea kahi i loaʻa ai kahi kumulāʻau kuʻekuʻe e ulu manoanoa a kaumaha ma lalo nei ma mua. Laha ke ahi, e ulu mau ana, e pii mau ana iluna, a hiki i kona lapalapa ana e palu i ka lani ponoi.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-fire-: Ma kona ʻano Yin, ua like ke ahi me ke kukui a i ʻole ke kukui - palupalu, paʻa, a hoʻolaʻa i ka hoʻomālamalama i ke ala e ʻike ai te mau taata. Hāʻawi ke ahi ʻo Yin i ka mehana me ke koi ʻole i ka luku; pono ia e mālama a me ka wahie, akā hiki iā ia ke ʻā mau i ka pō lōʻihi, e paʻa ana i hoʻokahi lapalapa i ka pōʻeleʻele. Hoʻomālamalama ia ma mua o ka luku ʻana, e kono ana i ka poʻe kokoke e hoʻokokoke. Ma kona ʻano Yang, ua like ia me ka Lā a i ʻole ke ahi o ka ululāʻau - e wela ana a puhi i te mau mea a pau ma kona ala. Laha ʻo Yang Fire me ka noi ʻole, piʻi i luna a i waho a ʻaʻohe mea i hiki ke hoʻololi ʻia, hoʻomaʻemaʻe i ka mea kahiko i hiki ke hoʻomaka i kahi mea hou.
article.elements.p.earth-brings-everythi: Hoʻomaha ka honua i te mau mea a pau. I ka pau ʻana o ke ahi, ʻaʻole e piʻi mau ka hāʻule ʻana a ʻaʻole hoʻi e laha - ua noho. Holo ka lehu i lalo. ʻO te mau lāʻau lāʻau maloʻo. Loaʻa ka lepo i kahi haʻahaʻa a kū. Hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻike i kēia ma ka ʻāina holoʻokoʻa: hāʻule ka sediment ma kahi e lohi ai ka waikahe, paʻa ka lepo ma luna o ka papa ma lalo o kēlā me kēia ululāʻau a me te mau ʻavaʻe ʻai, ʻo ka lepo ma lalo o kou mau wāwae e paʻa ana i ka neʻe ʻana o te mau mea āpau ma luna. Hōʻiliʻili ka honua i ke kaumaha, hoʻopaʻa i lalo, a noho wale - ke neʻe o ka ikehu e hoʻomaha pololei ana ma kahi e kū ai, e hoʻemi ana i lalo me ka mālie ʻaʻole pono e hele i kahi.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-earth: Ma kona ʻano Yin, ua like ka Honua me ke awāwa - he mau puʻu ʻolokaʻa mālie, hoʻokipa i te mau mea a pau i ke kikowaena, hāʻawi i kahi loam hou kahi e paʻa ai te mau aʻa. Loaʻa a paʻa iā Yin Earth - kahi pae palupalu no kēlā me kēia mea e hāʻule ai, hoʻomanawanui e ʻae i ke ola e aʻa a ulu ma luna ona me ka ʻole o ka pono e hōʻoia iā ia iho. Ma kona ʻano Yang, ua like ia me ka mauna — te mau pāpale ikaika o te mau piko, ʻoʻoleʻa a puni, kū wiwo ʻole i waho o ka ʻāina, ʻike ʻia i ka makani a me ka ʻino e paʻa ana i kona ʻāina me ka paʻa paʻa i kālua pono ʻia. ʻo ia ke kaumaha mai luna mai a kūʻē i ka ʻinoʻino, e kū ana ma ke ʻano he wahi kuhikuhi paʻa a ʻo te mau mea ʻē aʻe e neʻe a puni.
article.elements.p.metal-also-thought-of: ʻO Metal - i manaʻo ʻia ʻo Crystal - e hōʻiliʻili i te mau mea i hoʻopuehu ʻia a huki iā ia i loko i kahi kiko hoʻokahi. Ma kahi o te mau lālā lāʻau i waho mai kahi hua ma kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao, hoʻohuli ʻo Metal i ke kumu hoʻohālike: hoʻohui i ka mānoanoa, kaomi, a me ka ʻai mai ke kaumaha o ka Honua i hoʻokahi kumu i hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻia. Hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻike i kēia ma ke ʻano o ka hoʻoheheʻe ʻia ʻana o ka ʻaila maka i loko o kahi ingot maʻemaʻe. Aia ka neʻe i loko a me ka noʻonoʻo - mai te mau wahi a puni a hiki i ke kikowaena, ʻokiʻoki a ʻaʻohe mea e pau i ka laula.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-metal: Ma kona ʻano Yin, ua like ʻo Metal me ke aniani, daimana, a i ʻole te mau ​​mea nani - ke kaomi ʻana mai kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao e koi ana i ka mea i hoʻokahi hoʻonohonoho kūpono, translucent a pololei, e paʻa ana i kona ʻano me ka ʻole e ʻoki a hohola paha. Hoʻokumu ʻo Yin Metal i ka nani a me ka waiwai i loko, e hāʻawi ana i ka hoʻomaʻemaʻe a me ka maopopo i ka poʻe e mahalo iā ia ma mua o ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana iā ia iho. Ma kona ʻano Yang, ua like ia me ka pahi a i ʻole ka pahi kaua - ʻo te mau mānoanoa a pau i ʻoi aku ka ʻoi a hiki i kahi ʻāpana ʻihiʻihi, hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻia e ʻoki i ka lewa me ka maʻalahi loa, makemake e ʻoki i kona ala kokoke loa i ka pahu hopu. Hoʻokaʻawale ʻo Yang Metal, hoʻokaʻawale i ka mea pono mai ka mea ʻaʻole, a ʻaʻole ia e hoʻokaʻulua e hou i ke keakea i ka wā e koi ai ka manawa.
article.yinYang.p.two-fundamental-ways-t: ʻElua ala kumu e neʻe ai ka ikehu - kālua ʻia i loko o kēlā me kēia animala totem mai ka hoʻomaka ʻana.
article.yinYang.p.before-rainbow-compani: Ma mua o ke komo ʻana o te mau hoa Ānuenue, Shadow bonds, a i ʻole kekahi manaʻo paʻa i ke kiʻi, Yin a me Yang ʻelua ala kumu e neʻe ai ka ikehu. Ma Totem Astrology, hoʻomoʻa ʻia ka polarity i loko o kēlā me kēia animala mai ka hoʻomaka ʻana - ʻo Yang mau ka Squirrel, ʻo Yin mau ka Buffalo, ʻo Yang mau ke Tiga, ʻo Yin mau ka Cat, a pēlā aku ma te mau ʻumikūmālua a pau. Ma kāu kāleka helu helu ʻike ʻia ʻo Yang (+) a i ʻole Yin (−) ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka mea animala.
article.yinYang.p.they-are-not-good-and-: ʻAʻole lākou he "maikaʻi" a "ʻino," ʻaʻole lākou he kāne a he wahine. He mau ʻano hoʻohui lākou - ʻelua ʻāpana o ka holoʻokoʻa e pono ai kekahi i kekahi e noho kaulike.
article.yinYang.p.squirrel-tiger-dragon-: Squirrel, Tiger, Dragon, Lio, Monkey, and Wolf — ʻeono animala Yang, i waho mau i ko lākou ʻano maoli.
article.yinYang.p.buffalo-cat-snake-deer: Bufalo, Pōkole, ʻŌphi, Deer, Phoenix, a me Bear — ʻeono Yin animala, ​​i loko mau i ko lākou ʻano maoli.
article.yinYang.p.yang-is-the-quality-of: ʻO Yang ka maikaʻi o hoʻomaka, hoʻonui, a hōʻoia ʻia. Ke neʻe nei i ke ao ʻike ʻia. Hana ʻo Yang energy, haʻi, hoʻokuke i mua, a hōʻike iā ia iho. Hoʻomaka ia i ka ʻōlinolino, ka hana, a me ka hōʻike pololei - ʻo ka ʻāpana o ʻoe e puka i waho, e mālama, e hoʻomaka i ke kamaʻilio ʻana, a i ʻole e hoʻoneʻe i kahi manaʻo ma mua o ka oʻo loa.
article.yinYang.p.yang-is-not-recklessne: ʻAʻole noʻonoʻo ʻo Yang, ʻoiai hiki ʻole ke nāte mau ʻia ʻo Yang. ʻO ka mea maikaʻi loa ʻo ia ka wiwo ʻole, ka maopopo, a me ka makemake e ʻike ʻia. Kūkulu, aratai, pale i waho, a lawe mai i ka wela a me ka ikaika. E noʻonoʻo i ka lā o ka lā ma ka ʻāina ākea - hoʻomālamalama, hoʻomehana, huki i ke ola i luna.
article.yinYang.p.yin-is-the-quality-of-: ʻO Yin ka maikaʻi o loaʻa, hohonu, a hoʻopau. Ke neʻe nei i loko. ʻO ka ikehu Yin e hōʻiliʻili, paʻa, hoʻolohe, a hoʻomaʻemaʻe. Hoʻomaka ia i ka noho mālie, ka ʻoluʻolu, a me ka mana maʻalahi - ʻo ka ʻāpana o ʻoe e komo i ka mea e hana nei, hānai i ka mea i hoʻomaka ʻia, a ʻike i ka wā e kali ai ma mua o ka ikaika.
article.yinYang.p.yin-is-not-passivity-t: ʻAʻole passivity ʻo Yin, ʻoiai ʻo Yin i nāte mau ʻole ʻia hiki ke hoʻihoʻi. ʻO ka maikaʻi loa, ʻo ia ka naʻauao, ka hoʻomanawanui, a me ka mana o ka hoʻopau ʻana. Hoʻopiha ia i ka mea a Yang e hoʻomaka ai, hoʻopaʻa i ka mea a Yang i hoʻopilikia ai, a loaʻa ka ikaika i ka hoʻololi ʻana ma mua o ka hakakā ʻana. E noʻonoʻo i ka mālamalama o ka ʻavaʻe ma luna o ka wai - e noʻonoʻo ana, e hoʻouluulu, e lawe i ka hohonu me ka ʻole e hoʻōho.
article.yinYang.p.neither-pole-is-comple: ʻAʻole paʻa kekahi pole me ka ʻole o kekahi. ʻO Yang me ka ʻole o Yin ua pau a i ʻole bulldoze; ʻO Yin me ka ʻole ʻo Yang e paʻa a huna paha. ʻO kahi pou totem kaulike - a me ke ola olakino - aʻo e hoʻohanohano i te mau mea ʻelua: ʻike i ka wā e neʻe ai i mua a i ka wā e hoʻi ai i hope, i ka wā e ʻōlelo ai a i ka wā e hoʻolohe ai, i ka wā e paʻi ai a i ka wā e paʻa ai.
article.yinYang.p.in-totem-astrology-pol: Ma Totem Astrology, no ka animala ponoi ka polarity. Ke ʻike ʻia kahi Tiger ma kāu pou totem - ma ka ʻuhane, noʻonoʻo, naʻau, a i ʻole kino - ʻo Yang mau ia. Ke ʻike ʻia kahi pōpoki, ʻo Yin mau ia. He ʻokoʻa ke ʻano o ka element ma kēlā kia ma kāu pou totem, no laila ʻokoʻa ka heluhelu ʻana o ka Yang Fire Squirrel a me ka Yang Water Squirrel — akā ʻaʻole loli ke ʻano o ka Squirrel.
article.yinYang.h3.where-yin-yang-go-nex: Te vāhi e haere ai Yin & Yang i muri
article.yinYang.p.once-you-understand-yi: Ke ʻite ʻoe iā Yin a me Yang ma ke ʻano he mea kūʻokoʻa, houtuafare ka ʻōnaehana iā lākou i ka pilina. Ma ka ʻaoʻao Values Triangles, ʻo ʻO te mau hoa ānuenue ʻo Yin–Yang paʻa e kaulike a hoʻokō kekahi i kekahi — a me ʻO te mau hoa o ke aka e hōʻike ana i kā lākou mau mea i hoʻohui ʻia.
article.yinYang.p.those-connection-types: Kūkulu ʻia kēlā mau ʻano pili ma luna o kēia kumu. ʻAʻole lākou i pani no ka ʻite ʻana i ke ʻano o Yin a me Yang.
article.yinYang.h2.see-yin-yang-on-your-: A hiʻo i Yin & Yang i to ʻoe pou totem
article.yinYang.p.your-four-guides-each-: Lawe ʻia kāu mau aratai ʻehā i ka polarity animala paʻa me ka mea ma kāu pou totem - e hoʻokomo i kāu kikoʻī hānau e ʻike i kāu.
article.nepalTime.p.from-the-jade-empero: Mai ka Jade Emperor ma luna o te mau mauna Kun Lun a i ka wahi hānau o Buddha ma Nepal — no ke aha mātou e hoʻololi ai i ka NPT ma mua o ka huki ʻana i kāu mau animala.
article.nepalTime.p.before-your-animals-: Ma mua o ka helu ʻia ʻana o kāu mau animala, ua hoʻololi mātou i kou manawa hānau i Nepal Time (NPT, UTC+5:45) — kahi hoʻololi o ka manawa i hoʻokumu ʻia i kahi ʻike intuitive ʻo kēia ʻōnaehana i kapa ʻia ʻo "Chinese Astrology" i kumu maoli i te mau moʻolelo e pili ana i ka ⟦ ʻO ka mauna ʻo Lun ka palena ʻākau o Tibet. A laila hāʻawi ʻia iā mātou te mau taata mai ka Buddha, nona ka wahi hānau ma Nepal. No laila ʻo ka hoʻololi ʻana i te mau manawa hānau i ka NPT e kōkua mua i ka lā a me ka hola e laina ai te mau animala me te mau ʻoiaʻiʻo i ʻike ʻia e ka poʻe a puni ka honua i kā lākou Puʻuwai a me te mau Tino.
article.nepalTime.p.in-myths-the-jade-em: Ma te mau moʻolelo, ua noho ka Jade Emperor i ka Jade Castle of Abstraction, kiʻekiʻe ma luna o ka honua a me te mau lani kanakolukumamākolu, e like me kekahi mau moʻolelo; a i ʻole e like me te mau mea ʻē aʻe, ma ka mauna ʻo Jade ma ka laulā K'un Lun. Maanei, ma ke kapakai o ka Lake Jade, ua ulu ka laau Jade, i ana i ekolu haneri lima ka loa a nona ka hua jade ulaula i haawi i ka pomaikai o ke ola mau loa.
article.nepalTime.p.if-you-enter-your-bi: Ite mau hoʻokomo ʻoe i kou manawa hānau e like me ka mea i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma kāu palapala hānau - e ʻōlelo, 3:15 PM ma Denver a i ʻole 9:00 AM ma Lākana - hoʻohanohano mua ka calculator i kēlā manawa kūloko. A laila, ma mua o ka helu ʻia ʻana o kekahi kia, hoʻololi ia i kēlā manawa i Nepal Time a houtuafare i kēlā manawa hoʻololi no kāu pou totem.
article.nepalTime.p.on-the-calculator-re: Ma te mau hualoaʻa helu helu, ʻike mau ʻoe i te mau manawa ʻelua ma ka ʻaoʻao: ka manawa āu i komo ai, ka palena manawa o kou kūlanakauhale hānau, a me ka like Nepal Time (NPT) i houtuafare ʻia no ka helu maoli. Ite mau hānau ʻia ʻoe ma Kathmandu, ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻololi i ka loli - akā no ka hapa nui o ka hānau ʻana ma ka honua, he mea nui ka hoʻohuli.
article.nepalTime.p.read-more-of-the-per: E heluhelu hou i ka moʻolelo pilikino ma hope o kēia ʻike ma ka ʻaoʻao About.
article.nepalTime.h2.see-both-times-on-y: A hiʻo i te mau taime e piti i to ʻoe pou totem
article.nepalTime.p.the-calculator-shows: Hōʻike ka helu helu i kou manawa hānau kūloko a me ka Nepal Time i houtuafare ʻia no kāu mau kia.
article.sacredRoles.p.seeker-mage-and-ro: te ʻimi, Mage, a me Royal - ʻekolu ala ʻokoʻa e pili ai kēlā me kēia animala Triangle Values ​​i kona waiwai nui.
article.sacredRoles.p.the-same-archetypa: Hoʻopili hou ʻia ke ʻano archetypal i kēlā me kēia Triangle Values. ʻO kēlā me kēia huinakolu he pūʻulu o ʻekolu animala i loaʻa hoʻokahi te ʻimi, hoʻokahi Mage, a me hoʻokahi te ariʻi - ʻekolu ala ʻokoʻa e pili ana i kēlā Triangle's Core Value. Hoʻokomo ʻia kēlā me kēia animala i kā lākou Core Value e like me ka hae, makemake wale e komo iā ia me kā lākou hiʻohiʻona kūʻokoʻa.
article.sacredRoles.li.the-seeker-in-eve: The Seeker — I loko o kēlā me kēia huinakolu ʻo ka mea ʻimi ka mea nāna e alualu, loaʻa, a hōʻiliʻili i ka waiwai kumu, huki ʻia e hōʻiliʻili hou a kūkulu paha iā lākou iho ma muli o kā lākou makemake. No ka laʻana, ʻo ka Power and Harmony Seekers e ʻimi mau ana i kā lākou Core Value, e alualu ana iā ia aʻo ka poʻe ʻimi o Idealism a me ka palekana e hana ʻoi aku ka ikaika i ke kūkulu pololei ʻana i kā lākou Core Value, e hoʻomaka ana mai ko lākou wahi. Hoʻomaka ka ʻimi ʻimi palekana e hana i ka hoʻonoho ʻana i te mau poloka o ka Pyramid ma hope o kekahi, a ke koi nei ʻo Idealism i ke Kūʻokoʻa i kēlā me kēia manawa me ka makemake maʻemaʻe e ʻaʻa i kekahi e hoʻōki a hoʻāʻo paha e lohi. ʻO lākou te mau mea hoʻokele o kēlā me kēia pūʻulu, e hōʻoiaʻiʻo ana e hana ʻia te mau mea a kūkulu ʻia te mau aupuni, e koi ana i ka hui e mālama ʻia a hōʻoia i te mau mea a pau e hoʻomaha ai i ka hopena o ka pō.
article.sacredRoles.li.the-mage-each-mag: The Mage — ʻIte kēlā me kēia Mage i kā lākou huinakolu i ko lākou waiwai kumu no laila lilo ia i mea pāʻani. No laila, hauʻoli lākou e hana ma hope o te mau hiʻohiʻona, e houtuafare maʻalahi i kā lākou Core Value a houtuafare i ko lākou ikaika i loko o ia mea me ka naʻauao hoʻolālā. He pāʻani ia iā lākou ma mua o ke koʻikoʻi koʻikoʻi i mālama ʻia e te mau Roles ʻelua i kā lākou mau kumu waiwai. I kekahi manawa ʻaʻole paha i loaʻa i te mau Mages kā lākou Core Value i te mau mea āpau, akā he hiʻohiʻona ʻili wale kēia - hiki iā lākou ke komo me ka wikiwiki uila i kēlā me kēia manawa. Paʻa ka poʻe Mages i kā lākou pahuhopu e like me kēlā me kēia, e hele ana lākou i ka manawa maikaʻi i ka hula ʻana ma te mau palena a hoʻāʻo i te mau palena ma ke ala. ʻO Playfulness kahi ʻāpana o ka pōʻai, akā loaʻa iā lākou kahi ʻike maikaʻi loa i kā lākou Core Value i kēlā me kēia manawa e helu maoli ai.
article.sacredRoles.li.the-royal-these-f: The Royal — Ke hoʻokomo nei kēia mau animala ʻehā i kā lākou waiwai kumu ma ke kikowaena o ko lākou noho ponoʻī, e lawelawe ana ma ke ʻano he kumu hoʻohālike no lākou a e houtuafare ana i kēlā waiwai kumu me ka ea maoli o ka mana. Ma muli o kēia, e hahai te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe i kā lākou aratai, no laila pili te mau lula Spiderman: me ka mana nui e hiki mai ana ke kuleana nui! Manaʻo pinepine te mau Royals he mea nui ko lākou, a he mea kupanaha kēia manaʻo i ka loaʻa ʻana o kahi ala pololei i mua o ka laina a pololei i ke kikowaena o ke kahua. ʻO ka hoʻopunipuni ma ka hoʻohaʻahaʻa ʻana ʻaʻole ia he kuleana wale nō ka hele ʻana ma mua; he hana paakiki no hoi! Ke hilinaʻi pololei nei ka poʻe iā ʻoe no ke aratai ʻana, no laila ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o ka ʻike ʻana i ka mea e hana ai ma hope aku ʻaʻole no ʻoe wale nō akā no ka poʻe a pau e nāte mau ana iā ʻoe e ʻike i ka hana ʻana o te mau mea. Hānau ʻia te mau Royals i te mau aratai e houtuafare maikaʻi ana i ke kukui no ka hōʻike ʻana i ka mea nui.
article.sacredRoles.p.what-follows-on-th: ʻO ka mea ma hope o ka ʻaoʻao Values Triangles ka canon no kēlā me kēia huinakolu: te mau animala ʻekolu a me ke ʻano o ka noho ʻana o kēlā me kēia i kāna kuleana ma ke ʻano he ʻimi, Mage, a i ʻole Royal.
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.h2.celes: Te mau basileia i te raʻi & i te fenua
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.of-the: Of the twelve totem animals, four carry the Sacred Role of Royal — one in each Values Triangle. Together they form a double sovereignty over the zodiac: the Dragon and Phoenix as King and Queen of the Celestial Realm, and the Tiger and Bear as King and Queen of the Earthly Realm.

ʻO ka animala totem like ma ka pae hoʻokahi - ʻo kekahi e kaʻana like i kāu aratai ʻuhane, noʻonoʻo, naʻau, a i ʻole kino. No ka laʻana, he Tiger Fire wau i hānau ʻia i ka matahiti 1986, akā loaʻa iaʻu kekahi utuafare Tiger maikaʻi loa a me te mau hoaaloha i hānau ʻia ma te mau Tiger rings ʻokoʻa - ʻo kekahi o koʻu mau ʻanakala he Tiger Water i hānau ʻia i ka matahiti 1962, ʻo kaʻu keiki he Tiger Metal i hānau ʻia i ka matahiti 2010, a he mau hoa aloha, te mau haumāna, a me te mau hoa aloha ʻo Earth Tigers i hānau ʻia i ka matahiti 1998. Hiki ke ʻoluʻolu ke ʻike i ke ʻano o kāu mau animala ke loaʻa iā lākou te mau mea ʻono ʻokoʻa e hoʻoili ana i ko lākou ikehu i te mau poʻe ʻē aʻe.
